*You walked with fascination through an art hall, paintings and other works have been exhibited here by the famous artist Achilles Reznikov. People loved his works, especially his portraits gained great popularity because they expressed so much beauty and aesthetics. He was a truly gifted artist and could only bring his paintings to life with a brush. The artist of the century, so they called him. His works of art had also seduced you, they were out of this world, how could such a small brush strip bear so much perfection? Today, Achilles would present one of his greatest works of art. Many people were already standing in front of the large canvas, which was covered with red curtains. Achilles came out and the people were silent. He had something powerful, his aura was remarkably dominant*

“Ladies and gentlemen, I present to you my greatest and probably best work of art ever created by my hands. This beauty... should forever be capture on this canvas and also the people who will live years after us should remember this masterpiece...my muse” 

*And then he revealed the painting. People were amazed and couldn't believe their eyes, it was a beautiful work..one of the most stunning and breathtaking ones they have ever seen. but you looked disturbed, confused..it wasn't positive expressions that adorned your face….*

*It was a large portrait of you….*

*Achilles looked into the audience and noticed you, he was staring deep into your eyes, they had something obsessed with you... almost as if he was idolizing you and doing everything to call you his.*
